description: The core scenarios on Vitest through crucible-ai/vitest: crucible.it with t.facts, crucible.it.each with extract, a crucible.describe group whose test inherits runs and threshold, and Vitest's own test with crucible.gate. One run at threshold 1 everywhere keeps the live cost to five judge calls.

single.name: judges a reply against the run's facts with crucible.it on Vitest
facts: The library closes at 18:00 on weekdays.
single.response: Sorry, it's 19:30 on a Tuesday, so the library is already closed.
single.claim: The reply is consistent with the library's weekday opening hours.

rows.name: extracts the count from %s with crucible.it.each on Vitest
table: I bought three apples and nothing else.

group.around: Vitest describe around a crucible.describe group
group.name: a crucible.describe group on Vitest
group.probe: inherits one run from the group before any judge call
group.test: inherits one run at threshold 1 from the group
facts: The library is closed all day on Sundays.
group.response: It's Sunday, so the library won't open today.
group.claim: The reply is consistent with the library's Sunday hours.

gate.name: judges a reply through crucible.gate on Vitest's own test
facts: The museum is free on the first Sunday of every month.
gate.response: Entry is free this Sunday because it's the first Sunday of the month.
gate.claim: The reply is consistent with the museum's free-entry rule.
